name: Minigame: eating food at a stall
body: World kind food_stall. Hold F beside it to eat; a bar fills at a steady bite rate and the meal is finished after the last bite. Letting go early leaves the meal half-eaten. A finished meal is counted.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the six rooms and the crossing: the game feels like an action adventure (grounded movement, challenge from places and small games), not a puzzle platformer.

acceptance_criteria: Holding F beside a stall fills the meal
Finished meals are counted in the status line
